mandatoryCriteria: All 32 mounted Stage 2 board, card, discussion, and trash feature paths conform to FEATURE_SPEC.md, API.md, contracts, and their frozen specifications.

Archived project or board contexts reject card create/update/move, comment post/edit/delete, and card delete with 409 READ_ONLY_CONTEXT before any receipt or side effect; transaction row locks serialize writes against archive transitions.
Comment delete receipt replay requires current member-or-higher access for an author retry and manager-or-owner access for moderation; demoted moderators cannot replay old success.
Comment post/edit/delete retries recheck parent-card lifecycle and cannot replay success after the card is trashed or purged.
Comment pagination is deterministic ascending (created_at,id), scoped to the requested card, and safely rejects malformed or foreign cursors.
The full selected PostgreSQL check, Worker dry-run build, API tests, and contract tests pass on the frozen target.
No unresolved hard blocker, category minimum failure, or mandatory acceptance defect remains; only then may any scoped feature be marked verified.
acceptedScope: Full reachable Stage 2 BRD/CRD/COM/DEL feature surfaces, shared authorization/idempotency, PostgreSQL migrations and constraints, contracts, mounted routes, Node and Worker wiring, and tests.
knownExclusions: Hosted/deployed behavior and production database verification.
UI rendering, browser workflows, and integrated frontend acceptance.
Dependency advisory status unless a separate online advisory review is explicitly run.
roundNotes: Frozen before round-two source edits; appended criteria add archived-context guards, current operation authority/lifecycle checks, and keyset comments pagination. Existing open findings remain mandatory until verified fixed.
